description: This file defines a Java interface named TransactionService that extends a generic service interface for handling transactions. It declares methods related to obtaining specific types of transactions (capturable and refundable) and listing transactions associated with an order.

classes.name: TransactionService
classes.description: A Java interface for managing transaction-related operations, including retrieving specific transactions and listing transactions for an order.

methods.name: getCapturableTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a previous transaction with type 'authorize' that can be captured for a given order.

methods.name: getRefundableTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a transaction that is eligible for a refund for a given order.

methods.name: listTransactions
methods.description: Lists all transactions associated with a specific order.
